sources.title: What is Parole?

summary: Current Texas Board of Pardons and Paroles guidance describes parole as discretionary release and explains that TDCJ identifies cases for review before eligibility, an Institutional Parole Officer prepares a case summary, and a three-member parole panel makes the decision by majority vote.
title: Texas BPP parole review process
